steps.en: Officer manually searches notices by warrant number
steps.id: Officer mencari notice lewat nomor warrant secara manual
steps.why_en: No automatic recognition of warrant notices exists.
steps.why_id: Pengenalan notice berwarrant secara otomatis tidak ada.

steps.en: Officer manually filters notices by court mention date
steps.id: Officer memfilter notice lewat court mention date secara manual
steps.why_en: Only a manual filter exists; nothing selects defendants automatically.
steps.why_id: Hanya filter manual; tidak ada seleksi defendant otomatis.

steps.en: OCMS lists the defendant IDs to be checked with agencies
steps.id: OCMS menyusun daftar ID defendant untuk dicek ke agency
steps.why_en: The agency upload covers reminder and DN stages only, not warrant stages.
steps.why_id: Upload ke agency hanya mencakup stage reminder dan DN, bukan stage warrant.
